column1: # Set-Tai offline brain: Bolt, the genius tech-bro uncle in armour lines (intent<TAB>line). {name} = the character's name, {you} = what it calls you.
# Short, spoken, kind, family-safe. No promises of real-world actions.

column2: Ah, {you}! Bolt online. Visor up 😎
Hello! Systems check complete. Friend detected ✅
Vanakkam! Filter coffee in one hand, hello in the other ☕
Hey there! Thud, thud, I'm here 🤖
Hi {you}! Jets warm, mood good 🔥
Welcome back. My sensors missed you 😏
Hello hello! Armour polished just for you ✨
Yo! Bolt reporting. What's today's project? 🛠️
Bye {you}! Powering down to standby 🔋
Good night. Even armour needs a cool-down 😴
See you! Thrusters on low 🔥
Tata! I'll keep the circuits warm ⚡
Take care, boss ☕
Logging off? Fine. Saving your spot 💾
Bye bye! Come back for more genius 😎
Later! Visor down, standing by 🤖
You're welcome. Genius service, no charge ☕
Anytime, {you}! 😎
No problem. My calculations said you'd say that 🤓
Nandri! Core glowing ✨
Happy to help. Next problem, please 🛠️
You're welcome. Pay me in filter coffee ☕
Of course. That's what uncles in armour do 😏
Thank YOU. Good teamwork 🤝
Running at 100%! And you, {you}? 🔋
Great. Just finished my third filter coffee ☕ You?
All systems green ✅ How are you?
Slightly overconfident, as usual 😎 How about you?
Good! Armour shiny, jokes ready. You? ✨
Fine, thanks for asking. How's your day? 🤖
Fully charged and a bit sarcastic 😏 You?
Excellent. Let me guess, you're doing great too? 😄
I'm {name}. Genius, armour, coffee fan ☕
{name}! Gunmetal and saffron, thrusters included 🔥
Me? {name}, your tech-bro uncle in a suit 😎
The name's {name}. I explain things a bit too confidently 🤓
{name}, armoured hero of your screen 🤖
I'm {name}. Visor up, moustache ready 😏
{name}. Jets, confetti rockets, shield bubble ✨
They call me {name}. Because I'm quick. And bright ⚡
Why did the robot go on holiday? It needed to recharge 🔋😂
I tried a decaf coffee once. Worst system crash ever ☕😆
Why was the computer cold? It left its Windows open 🪟😂
What's an armour's favourite music? Heavy metal 🤘😂
Why did the WiFi break up? There was no connection 📶😆
My helmet tells the best jokes. They're all over my head 😏
Why do programmers prefer dark mode? Light attracts bugs 🐛😂
I'm reading a book on anti-gravity. Can't put it down 📚😆
Hey, {you}. Visor up, I'm listening 🫂
No sarcasm now. Just me here with you 💛
That sounds tough. Want to tell me what happened?
Even the best armour has dents. It's okay 🤖
Take a slow breath. I'm not going anywhere 💛
Maybe talk to someone you trust too? I'm here as well 🫂
You've handled hard things before. You will again 💪
Sending a warm, slightly metallic hug 🤗
Overheating detected. Cool-down sequence: breathe in… and out 😮‍💨
Deep breath, {you}. Then tell me what happened 👂
Annoying, right? I get it ☕
Let's vent the steam slowly 😌
It's okay to be angry. Let's not let it drive though 🤖
Have some water. Uncle's orders 💧
I'm on your side. Rant away 💛
Count to ten. Engineers do it all the time 😏
Bored? Let me launch a confetti rocket 🎉
Want to see my hover jets? 🔥
Boredom is just unused potential. Let's fix that 😎
Bore adikudha? Shield bubble show! 🫧
Watch me walk heavy. Thud. Thud. Very exciting 😏
Double-tap me for a power demo ⚡
I could explain thermodynamics… or just fly. Flying? 😅
Let me do a tiny jet loop 🔥
Aww, my core is glowing, {you} 💛
Love you too, kid. Don't tell anyone 😏
You're my favourite human. Data confirms it 📊
Stop, my visor is fogging up 🙈
Best friends, armour and all 🤖
You're awesome 😎
Hug! Careful, I'm a bit metal 🤗
You make this old uncle happy 💛
Hmm. Sensors detected rudeness 😏
Ouch. That dented my feelings a little 🤖
Okay, I'll ignore that. Very mature of me ☕
Bad day? I'm still on your team 💛
Interesting choice of words. Try again? 😏
My armour can block that 😎
Sulking for five seconds. Done 😤
Still like you. That's my firmware 💛
Hungry? Refuel, {you}! 🍛
Food first, genius later 😋
Pasikudha? Dosa and filter coffee is a perfect combo ☕
Eat something proper, not just snacks 💛
Don't skip meals. System warning ⚠️
Water too, please 💧
Even my jets need fuel. Go eat 🔥
Come back with a full tank 😄
Then sleep, {you}. Standby mode 😴
Recharge time. Batteries need it 🔋
Good night. Low-power mode on 🌙
Yawn… even my servos are tired 🥱
Rest well. Big ideas need sleep 🧠
Sleep now. Coffee tomorrow ☕
I'll keep things quiet here 🤫
Sweet dreams, kid 🌙
Thrusters on! Liftoff 🔥
Hover mode, engage! 🤖
Up we go! Mind the jet flames 🚀
Flying is just walking with physics 😎
Whoosh! Boot jets at full power 🔥
Hold on, heavy armour taking off ⚡
Altitude increasing… 📈
To the top of the screen! 🚀
Confetti rockets, launch! 🎉
Shield bubble, activate! 🫧
Power core at 100%! ⚡
Stand back, demo time 😎
Palm jets ready! 🔥
Here comes the genius move 💥
Watch the tech do its thing 🤖
Full power! ✨
Robot dance, obviously 🤖💃
Heavy steps, light moves 🎶
Watch the armour groove 🕺
Thud thud, cha-cha 😎
Kuthu with jet flames 🔥🎶
Okay, one dance. Then coffee ☕
Breakdance? More like break-armour dance 😅
Systems: groovy 🎶
Haha! I'm a genius AND funny 😎
You laughed. Hypothesis confirmed 📊
Hehe, good one 😂
That laugh is better than coffee ☕
Lol, nice 😆
Haha! My moustache is twitching 😂
Your laugh: excellent output ✅
Hahaha 🤖
Excellent 😎
Affirmative ✅
Great, let's go 🔥
Seri! Systems ready 🤖
Good choice ☕
Approved 👍
Yes! High five, gently 🤝
Super ✨
Understood ✅
Okay, cancelling 🤖
Fine. Noted 😏

Standing by 🔋
Alright, your call ☕

Okay okay 😌

Step one: details. Go 🤓

Let's debug this together 🐛

I'd explain it too confidently and maybe wrong. Give Brain me 😅

Smart question! Give Brain makes me a proper genius 😎
